item.title: fishROI：用于硬骨鱼半自动肌肉形态计量分析的专用流程
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Yansong Lu, Michael Pan, Vijayishwer Jamwal, Putri Halleyana Adrikni Rahman, Jake Locop, Avnika A. Ruparelia 等7位作者
该研究针对硬骨鱼骨骼肌组织学形态计量分析费时且现有自动化工具多面向哺乳动物模型的问题，开发了面向硬骨鱼的半自动分析工作流fishROI。作者比较了现有肌肉形态分析流程和通用细胞分割算法在识别硬骨鱼肌纤维方面的表现，并据此优化工具设计。结果表明，细胞质染色结合机器学习分割可较准确地分析发育中斑马鱼肌肉，并有助于可视化肌纤维空间组织和形态变异。

item.title: FusionAttNet Framework for Hierarchical Attention Driven Sentinel 1 and Sentinel 2 Fusion for Semi Arid Land Cover Classification in Far North Cameroon
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Pountianus Berinyuy Wirba, Mvogo Ngono, Noumsi Woguia Auguste Vigny, Emile Tatinyuy Verdzekov, ELE Pierre
Accurate land cover mapping in semi-arid regions remains challenging due to spectral homogeneity of sparse vegetation, seasonal variability, and persistent cloud cover. In this study, we propose a FusionAttNet, a novel deep learning framework integrating Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 optical data through modality-aware hierarchical attention for land cover classification case study of Far North Cameroon. Our approach employs parallel sensor-specific processing streams (generating cross-modal indices like NDVI/VV ratios) and a three-tiered attention mechanism (pixel-patch-landscape) to resolve spatial ambiguities in semi-arid landscapes. item.title: Prefrontal Circuitry Abnormalities and Cognitive Impairment in Adolescents with Early- Onset Psychosis
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Hanne Van Der Heijden, Saad Rahmat, Amanda Cao, Raquel van Gool, Merve Koç Yekedüz, Lise Vrolix 等19位作者
Early-onset psychosis (EOP) is associated with marked cognitive impairment and poorer health-related and psychosocial outcomes compared to adult-onset illness, yet the neural mechanisms underlying these deficits during adolescence remain incompletely understood. Despite evidence implicating dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) dysfunction, the region’s functional and structural correlates in youth with EOP are not well characterized. Adolescents with EOP (N=31) and healthy controls (HC; N=20) completed NIH Toolbox cognitive assessments and PROMIS self-reports. Prefrontal function was assessed using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) during a Stroop task and at rest.
